title: Checkbox
summary: Checking a box now feels physical: the tick is drawn in, the box pops from 70% to full size, and pressing squeezes it to 96%. The pointer target grows by 4px on every side (28 x 28 for the default 20px box) without moving anything, hover only applies on devices that can hover, and an optional description line can sit under the label.
why: Untitled UI and HeroUI draw the tick with a stroke animation and scale the filled box in; our tick only faded.

Material and Apple HIG minimum targets are 44-48px; 20px boxes are far below WCAG 2.5.8's 24px minimum. Radix Themes and Mantine extend the clickable area with the label; here a 4px invisible ring is added around the box itself.
HeroUI and Untitled UI support a supporting-text line under the label; Radio in this system already had one.

scenarioLabels.gallery-states: All states and sizes (unchanged at rest)
scenarioLabels.toggle-check: Checking (frame samples: stroke offset 26px to 0, box scale .7 to 1)

motion.before: Fade/zoom keyframe that never ran (values reset, see notes): the tick appeared instantly
motion.after: Stroke draws from the start of the path: stroke-dashoffset 26 to 0, 150ms linear, 15ms delay (check: dash 24 gap 30; minus: dash 15 gap 20, offset 17 to 0). Stroke width stays 3.

Scale .7 to 1 over 200ms, --v2-ease-spring (a sampled critically damped spring; in Figma use a custom spring or Smart Animate 'Gentle' / bezier 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) (fill and border are one solid shape so the whole box scales)
Scale 1 to .96 in 80ms; back in 200ms, spring. Disabled boxes do not press

motion.before: 120ms fade/zoom (values reset, so no visible effect)
motion.after: 120ms fade and shrink to 85% (now actually runs)
No pop, no scale, no stroke draw: the tick fades in over 150ms; colours still transition 150ms

states: Checkbox / every size (sm 16, default 20, lg 24) x unchecked / checked / indeterminate x default / hover / focus / disabled: unchanged at rest
Checkbox / hit area: 4px invisible padding on each side (new annotation, not visible)
figmaSteps: On every Checkbox size, wrap the box in a transparent frame 4px larger on each side: sm 24 x 24, default 28 x 28, lg 32 x 32 (box centred, no fill, no stroke). The frame is the clickable area; component width in layouts stays the box width (use negative margin -4px or 'ignore auto layout').
Add a 'Pressed' variant to every checked state: box scale 96%. Prototype default to pressed with Smart Animate 80ms ease-out, pressed to default 200ms Gentle spring.

Add the check animation as an interaction: unchecked to checked, Smart Animate 200ms Gentle spring, box scale 70% to 100%. Inside, the tick path: stroke dash offset (set the stroke 'dash' to 24 / gap 30 and animate the offset 26 to 0, or reveal the path with a 150ms linear wipe from the first point), delay 15ms. Same for indeterminate, dash 15 / gap 20.

Add an optional 'Description' text layer to the labelled Checkbox: Inter 12px / 16px regular, colour --v2-text-muted #707070, 4px below the label (same offset as Radio), left-aligned with the label. Auto layout: horizontal, gap 8px, align top; the label row is as tall as the box (sm 16, default 20, lg 24) so the box lines up with the first line of the label. Left-label placement mirrors it. Disabled: whole text block at 50% opacity.

Hover fills stay as they are (unchecked hover --semantic-bg-ui #F5F5F5 with border --color-primary-100 #C0C3CA; checked hover --semantic-primary-hover #2F384D). Note in the component description that hover only applies on pointer devices.
notes: The brief expected a keyframe on mount for the tick; keyframes cannot be added from this file, so the tick uses a stroke-dashoffset transition with `@starting-style` supplying the 'from' value when the Radix indicator mounts already checked. Browsers without @starting-style (Chrome < 117, Safari < 17.5, Firefox < 129) show the tick instantly; everything else still works.

Pre-checked boxes also animate once when they first mount (the tick draws and the box pops), the same as the previous tick pop did on mount. A page full of pre-checked boxes will animate at load; say if this should be suppressed (needs an 'interacted' flag).

FOUND: the previous tick pop (`motion-safe:animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-[0.85]`) was a silent no-op: tailwindcss-animate's `.animate-in` resets the enter variables and its motion-safe copy is emitted after the plain zoom/fade utilities. The new box pop and exit use `motion-safe:zoom-in-[0.7]`, `motion-safe:fade-out-0` etc. so they actually run (verified: scale 0.7 at the first frame).
Description spacing is 4px (Radio's actual `mt-1`), not the 2px quoted in the task; one class (`mt-1` to `mt-0.5`) changes both if 2px is wanted.
Selectable-card variant for Checkbox was not added (Radio only): the checkbox label markup (wrapping label / separateLabel) does not fit a whole-card target without duplicating it.
The 4px hit ring can overlap an adjacent control that sits closer than 4px; none of the stories do.

Hit area implementation: `before:-inset-[5px]`, not `-inset-1`. An absolutely positioned pseudo-element is offset from the padding box, which excludes the 1px border, so -4px would only reach 3px past the visible edge (26 x 26). Measured with elementFromPoint in Chrome: the target is 24 / 28 / 32px for sm / default / lg, a point 3.9px outside the box hits the checkbox and a point 5px outside does not.
